text.p: The following are scheduled Australian holidays for 1997 and the rest of 1996.
Tue 5 Nov Melbourne Cup (public holiday in Melb only)
Wed 25 Dec Christmas Day (public and market holiday)
Thu 26 Dec Boxing Day (public and market holiday)
Wed 01 Jan New Year's Day (public holiday all states)
Mon 27 Jan Australia Day (public h/day except in VIC)
Mon 03 Mar Labour Day (public h/day in WA)
Mon 10 Mar Labour Day (public h/day in VIC)
Mon 17 Mar Canberra Day (public in ACT)
Fri 28 Mar Good Friday (public h/day all states)
Mon 31 Mar Easter Monday (public h/day all states)
Fri 25 Apr Anzac Day (public h/day all states)
Mon 05 May Labour Day (public h/day NT, QLD)
Mon 19 May Adelaide Cup (public h/day SA)
Mon 09 June Queen's Birthday (public h/day except in WA)
Mon 04 Aug Bank Holiday (Bank Holiday in NSW & NT)
Wed 13 Aug RNA Show Day (public h/day Brisbane Metro)
Mon 30 Sep Queen's Birthday (public h/day in WA)
Mon 06 Oct Labour Day (public h/day ACT, NSW, SA)
Tue 07 Oct Melbourne Cup (public h/day VIC)
Wed 25 Dec Christmas Day (public h/day all states)
Thu 26 Dec Boxing Day (public h/day all states)
-- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373 1800
